page.layout: One page of text inside a decorative woodcut border; running head at top with page number left and title right. No margin notes. Text in one column.

p.i: Omnes scientiæ naturales ac licitæ notæ fuerunt Salomoni: Scientia artis chemicæ, transformationem metallorum docens, Salomoni fuit ignota:
Ergo scientia artis chemicæ, de metallorum transformatione, nec naturalis, nec licita putanda est.

main_text.p: PRopositionis vis inde dependet, quod omnium mortalium sapientissimus fuerit Salomon, non solùm recti judicii excellentiâ, & actione ac prudentia politica, sed etiam, quod de omni quæsito rerum naturalium & contemplationis physicæ disseruerit, à Cedro Libani usq; ad hyssopum parietis, & de jumentis volucribus & de reptilibus ac piscibus: unde Re-

page.notes: The opening initial "P" is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "Ropositionis" as "PRopositionis". Printed text reads "Ropositionis" with the initial P as a separate large letter; transcribed as printed. Catchword "Re-" is the hyphenated start of the next page word, shown at foot right.
